sources.title: 生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法
sources.publisher: 国家互联网信息办公室等七部门
sources.license_summary: Official public government text; attributed Markdown snapshot retained for reference. No reuse permission is inferred for page chrome, images or third-party editorial content; any reuse remains subject to official terms.
allowed_uses: Article 2 scope for services that use generative AI to provide generated text, images, audio or video to the public within mainland China
Article 14 unlawful-content and service-handling duties, not a general user opt-out requirement
Article 15 complaint and reporting channels with timely handling; the Measures do not set a numeric statutory response deadline
Article 17 security-assessment and filing references only for services with public-opinion or social-mobilization capacity
prohibited_uses: legal opinion or case-specific compliance determination
inferring that a service completed filing or security assessment
generalizing the measures to every AI application, urban design project or non-generative system
inferring a general user opt-out right from Article 14, a numeric deadline from Article 15, or Article 17 duties for services without public-opinion or social-mobilization capacity
sources.notes_zh: 官方页面标注 2023-07-13 发布、2023-08-15 施行；第2条适用范围是向境内公众提供生成文本、图片、音频、视频等内容的生成式人工智能服务。第14条是违法内容与服务处置，不是一般用户退出权；第15条有投诉举报和及时处理要求，但没有法定数字响应期限；第17条安全评估、备案等表述仅针对具有舆论属性或社会动员能力的服务。快照仅供离线检索，正式引用仍以官方页面为准。
